title: Collab
proposition: Keep AI-assisted repository changes bounded, inspectable and human-approved.
story: Collab is Python and Bash developer tooling that constrains AI-assisted repository changes to one evidence-backed delivery at a time. It collects Git and GitHub context, validates structured handoffs, applies verified file-transfer packages and gates delivery through scope, build, test and consumer checks.
contribution: I designed the bounded planning and implementation stages, implemented deterministic evidence collection and immutable run records, enforced branch and scope guards, and developed read-only GitHub Actions diagnostic analysis.

reflection.summary: AI assistance becomes more accountable when evidence, authority, scope, mutation and acceptance are represented as explicit boundaries instead of informal expectations.

limitations: The project does not provide autonomous software delivery, repair or knowledge promotion.
Uniform DX v2 generation across every compatibility path is not established.
Production readiness, external adoption and successful execution of every GitHub mutation path are not established.

provenance.description: Mechanically derived from the controlling public projection.
